description: WP-G1 Codex: Orks (11e) KAPTIN'S HAT (Wreckas enhancement): 'When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly ORKS INFANTRY units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.' Fixture ork11e_enh_wreckas_redeploy (P1 Orks, Wreckas: the Warboss carries Kaptin's Hat and leads the Flash Gitz; P2 Custodes). P1 human (Attacker) vs P2 AI; setup privilege: P2's Custodian Guard is given Castellan's Mark so the AI also has a redeployment to resolve (players alternate, Attacker first). The panel lists the ORKS INFANTRY units only (Flash Gitz + Warboss as ONE row, Boyz; no Battlewagon, no separate Warboss). Real clicks: [Redeploy] Flash Gitz picks up the whole Attached unit (6 models); the model-type picker (docked in the redeploy panel) chooses Flash Gitz, six board clicks set up the five Gitz and then the Warboss inside the deployment zone; [Confirm Redeploy] -> both units at the clicked spots, still attached, 2 uses left. [Reserves] the Boyz -> Strategic Reserves past the reserves limit; P1 has nothing left, so the step passes to the AI's Player 2, which keeps its unit in place (AIDecisionMaker._decide_redeployment), and the step ends — no stall.

steps.comment: setup privileges (see description); P2 is the AI
steps.script:
GameState.state.units["U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B"].meta["enhancements"] = ["Castellan's Mark"]
FactionAbilityManager._razgit_redeploys_used = {"1": 0, "2": 0}
GameState.state.meta["attacker"] = 1
GameState.state.meta["defender"] = 2
AIPlayer.enabled = true
AIPlayer.ai_players = {1: false, 2: true}
return [FactionAbilityManager.get_redeploy_enhancement_name(1), FactionAbilityManager.get_redeploy_enhancement_name(2), AIPlayer.is_ai_player(2)]

steps.comment: ORKS INFANTRY only; the Attached unit is one row; Done hands over to P2
the whole Attached unit (5 Gitz + Warboss) is picked up
the Warboss (auto-selected once the Gitz are down)
Gitz and Warboss at the clicked spots, still one Attached unit
steps.script:
var fg = GameState.state.units.U_FLASH_GITZ_A
var wb = GameState.state.units.U_WARBOSS_A
return [Vector2(fg.models[0].position.x, fg.models[0].position.y).distance_to(Vector2(400, 160)) < 2.0, Vector2(wb.models[0].position.x, wb.models[0].position.y).distance_to(Vector2(540, 230)) < 2.0, int(fg.status) == 2 and int(wb.status) == 2, str(wb.get("attached_to", "")) == "U_FLASH_GITZ_A", FactionAbilityManager.get_razgit_redeploys_remaining(1) == 2]

steps.comment: P2 (AI) resolves its Castellan's Mark choice and the step ends
the AI kept its unit in place
